_comment: Every arm is a path under FN_ROOT. The GaussianFluent ones used to be an
absolute /workspace path that existed on one machine, so the comparison could
not be reproduced and did not survive that machine. code/fetch.sh WANT=gfluent
downloads them from the authors' Hugging Face release into gfluent/.
They publish eighteen objects and two of them are ours: watermelon and cake.
